prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: single fantasy inventory pixel-art sprite. First input image is edit target (or original design to restore). Preserve current pixel-art style, coarse square clusters, dark stepped outlines, palette and proportions except explicitly requested changes. Keep straight silver sword, blue gems, blue-white grip and coarse pixels. Add a clearly visible GOLDEN STRIPE inlaid along CENTER of sword blade, starting immediately above guard and extending nearly to sword tip (about90% blade length). Gold stripe narrow, crisp-edged, visibly distinct from silver steel, not diffuse glow. Make guard and hilt a little more splendid for legendary Excalibur: elegant layered gold scroll/angular wing details within existing overall guard width, tiny blue gem accents and gold grip bands. Preserve sword proportions. Entire visible art must fit within centered vertical strip width one-quarter image height, to occupy1x4 cells. Request768x2304; all art x110..650 and y35..2265; transparent margins. Do not extend guard outside that strip.
Return exactly ONE item. No text labels, watermark, grid or backdrop. Preserve real alpha transparency; no black background. No blurring or antialias smoothing. Full object with safe transparent margins. Inventory footprint (# occupied, . empty), top-to-bottom: #/#/#/#
